steps.content:
MBCC Temporary Mission Log
Time: ██/██/112
Location: High-risk zone, the Rust upstream.
Goal: Find Vera Schilder's remains.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Corruptors detected. Number: 4, distance: 10 meters... Chief!
Several black shadows sprung out from the ruins.
Bang—

Demon grabbed the Corruptor who jumped out first by the throat and slammed it to the ground. The sharp edge of his shield snapped its neck. The headless Corruptor twitched a few times and then stopped moving.
Find cover and shoot!
Under the cover of firepower, two Corruptors found it hard to advance and were quickly riddled with bullets.
Yet the last Corruptor dodged the guards ahead and lunged towards you.
Demon was the first to react. He used his shield to slam the Corruptor into the nearest concrete pillar, causing it to vomit out its internal organs.
The buildings in the Rust's no-man's land had long fallen into disrepair and simply could not withstand such an impact.
The dilapidated six-story building came crashing down.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Chief... zzzz... can you hear me? Chief! Please respond!
I can hear you. I'm fine.
Demon dusted off the debris from his body, stood up, and stared at you without saying a word.
...Demon is fine, too.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: We will be there... in twenty minutes... please wait where you are... please don't move...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Those sounds probably alerted all the Corruptors in the area...
Demon didn't continue, but you knew what he meant. To wait where you were equaled waiting for death.
We need to keep moving. With him around, we won't be in grave danger.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: But...
You knew he wanted to say that the person next to you was the gravest danger of all.
But there were no other options now.
I'll go to the destination first. You guys go back to the pick-up point and wait for me.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: ....Copy that.
You turned off the radio headset and waved to Demon.
They don't seem to trust you.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: They're right.
No matter what he said, Demon's personal abilities were trustworthy. Though the mission had been marred with countless dangers, it was reassuring to have Demon around.
Though he became thinner and gloomier after the trial, he was still the former Captain of the FAC Special Task Force renowned throughout the city.
We still have a mission to complete.
Demon did not deny it this time. He raised his shield and walked up to you. He had applied to take part in this mission himself.
There was only one goal to the mission—to find the remains of Demon's sister, Vera Schilder.
You pushed open a corroded iron door and entered a sanatorium.
The foul odor of dead bodies mixed with the putrid stench of mold, seared your eyes. In the corridor ahead, there were more than a dozen decomposed corpses on the floor.
There were Corruptors, and there were humans.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: This was the place.
Two months ago, agents from the 9th Agency came to this place. They found what they wanted.
However, some also died here.
When agents from the 9th Agency asked the judge to "identify the body," I thought...
They should've brought Vera along.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: That's not their responsibility.
Demon crouched down and prodded the severely decomposed corpse of a combatant.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: No risk of becoming a Corruptor...
He took off his cloak and put it over the corpse.
The elevator had long been out of use. You went all the way up the stairs and finally came to the door of the room you were looking for.
The dust in front of the door was thinner than in other places. The whole corridor was covered with footprints, especially in front of the door to this room.
You knew you were in the right place.
Demon put his hand on the doorknob. For the first time, you saw hesitation and withdrawal on his face.
Shall I wait for you outside for a bit?
Demon shook his head and twisted open the doorknob.
The room behind the door was only about eight square meters in size. There was a small skeleton curled up on a gray bed by the window.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Vera...
He limped over and knelt down in front of the bed. His movements were so gentle, as if fearing to wake up the sleeping girl.

Demon wanted to say something, but couldn't open his mouth. He crouched beside the bed as sunlight leaked through the cracks of the abandoned building, illuminating the dust flying among the shredded beams.
The time passed bit by bit, but Demon said nothing. The bloodcurdling shrieks of the Corruptors were getting closer and closer. You had to remind him.
We should go now...
Demon turned around and looked at you.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Hmm...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I know.
He packed the bones into his backpack piece by piece. He also took the dusty notebook by Vera's pillow.
After finishing, he got up and walked towards you.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Sorry to keep you waiting.
Demon forced a smile. He looked so fragile, with gaunt eyes seeping nothing but exhaustion and sorrow.
All around you, the shrieks of the Corruptors grew ever denser.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Let's go.
You and Demon traversed the crumbling ruins for quite some time. Corruptors were appearing more and more frequently.
Luckily, your destination was already quite close. You could already see the lights of the Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Be careful! Behind you!
Linda stands there thunderstruck, mouth hanging open.
Demon turned sideways and knocked down the Corruptor behind him. Squeezed between the ground and the shield, its head exploded, spurting foul-smelling gray liquid onto the ground.
A shard from the Corruptor's skull sliced open his hand, leaving a bloody wound.
This wave... is temporarily over. Thank you, Demon.
Contrary to your joyful relief, Demon dealt with his wound calmly, but without a hint of relief or joy in his voice.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Things are bad.
What are you worried about?
The guards have arrived at the pick-up point. We are very close to the borders of no man's land...
With your strength, we can definitely evacuate successfully. What are you worried about?
Demon looked up at the sky. The city lights tinted the hazy clouds ominously yellow, blocking out the stars.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Yes, very close...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: And that's the worst possible thing.
Gazing at the lights of the Syndicate neighborhoods, you suddenly realized what Demon meant.
The Corruptors will follow us all the way to the city...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: A lot of people will die.
I'll alert the FAC right away! They'll send help!

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: There's no time.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: How far is the nearest residential area?
You glanced at the satellite map.
2.5 kilometers away...
The distance is too short. By the time the FAC gets here, the streets would be awash with blood.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: They won't make it in time.
Demon quietly removed his backpack and took out the notebook. He then gave the backpack to you.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Please bury Vera for me.
He put the shield on the ground and pulled out the dagger from his waist.
Have you gone mad?!

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I will try to slow down the Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Go find the Bureau's guards and evacuate nearby residents. Wait until the FAC arrives before clearing things here.
Demon raised his head to look at the debris around him.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: The Syndicate has lost too much already. Someone needs to protect what's left.
You'll die...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: The whole thing started with my selfish desires. I have no excuse to flee.
There was no regret in his voice, only relief.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: For someone like me, dying here is the easy way out.
There are Bureau staffs nearby. I'll bring them to help you.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: It's no use. There are so few of them that they won't even be able to form a line of defense.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: They'd only distract me here.
But...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Go!
Demon scowled again, but unlike in the past, you weren't frightened.
Wait for me. I'll be back.
Watching the "Chief" who restrained him leave, a smile appeared on Demon's face.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Don't come back. It's not worth it.
He muttered to himself, shaking off the blood from his left hand.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I'm all alone again... this is for the best.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: This is for the best.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: After all... I couldn't protect anything.
Weak monsters always hunt in groups, otherwise they wouldn't be able to kill their prey.
They are ignorant, short-sighted, and beholden to their instincts.
That's why they're easy to control.
That was the knowledge Demon had summed up back at the Special Task Force. To this day, the same logic still applied.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Ahhh!
Demon roared and slammed into the Corruptor in front of him. The slender monster snapped into two, its blood and guts spilling onto the ground in a sticky mess.
The shrieks around him did not stop. This was the terrifying thing about Corruptors. They didn't fear death.
They were beholden to their instincts.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Come at me... you monsters...
In the darkness, endless waves of Corruptors surged forth, baring their fangs and claws to pounce on the lone warrior, before being torn to bits and washing away downstream.
In this carnival of slaughter, everything that moved became a sacrifice.

steps.speaker: Abel
steps.content: Vera, come.
The man waved to the little girl. Beside him stood a boy.

steps.speaker: Abel
steps.content: From now on, he is your older brother. Be nice to each other.
The little girl came over, but the boy stepped back instinctively. He didn't belong here. He was just a gangster from the Syndicate who jacked Abel's car, and he... killed people before.
But the little girl still walked over and took his hand.

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: Demon, my brother!
She smiled sweetly.

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: Let's go home together!
Swish—
The sharp claws left bloody gashes on Demon's face. He woke up with a start, and just for a moment, he lost focus.
The wounds on his body were increasing, and his eyes became a bit blurry.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: That was just a mirage from the past.
Demon kept warning himself. It was dangerous to be distracted during battle, and the Chief needed more time to evacuate the townsfolk. He couldn't fall down just yet.
Thanks to the power of Sinner, his left hand healed, leaving a shallow scab.
Demon tore off the scab. The pain stimulated his numb nerves, bringing about much-needed sobriety.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I won't make this kind of mistake again.

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: Demon, you need to eat...
Scars zigzagged across the boy's naked torso. He blushed and quickly put on his shirt.

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: What's that on your body...

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: Daddy says that you used to have a hard life, and that your former daddy beat you. Guess it's true...

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: But don't worry! My daddy is the best daddy in the whole wide world! He never scolds me unless I eat something bad and get a tummy ache.

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: I'll protect both you and Dad. From now on, no one will dare bully you!

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: Demon, are you leaving?
The boy nodded somewhat awkwardly. He deliberately chose such an early hour to leave, because he didn't know how to face parting with them.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I'm going to the Eastside Police Academy. Abel... Dad is very busy. I should learn something to help shoulder his burden.

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: I know...
The little girl sounded a bit aggrieved.

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: But I don't want you to go.
The boy smiled and patted her head.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Don't worry. I'll be back soon.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I'm sorry, Vera. I came back too late...
Demon touched the notebook in his breast pocket, muttering to himself.
It was the last part of his body that had not been soaked with blood.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Vera, I should have had a chat with you before I committed all these crimes...
Demon stood upright in the pool of blood. He was exhausted, and even the armor on his body became heavy from the bloodstains.
He needed to rest, if only for a little while. Perhaps he needed to chat with someone, even if it were a hallucination.
Demon closed his eyes, entering a world of boundless darkness.
A young man with a backpack slung over his shoulder knocked on the door hesitantly, but no one responded. When he twisted the doorknob, he found that the door was unlocked.
The house was dark.
Bam—

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: Happy birthday!
The lights in the house suddenly lit up, and colorful ribbons rained down from the ceiling. A young girl stood behind him with a cake in her hands.
The young man turned around, a warm smile on his face.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Thank you...
As he removed the ribbons stuck to the girl's head, he nodded towards the man on the sofa.

steps.speaker: Abel
steps.content: Cough cough...
The man stood up from the sofa. He aged a lot these past few years. But seeing his adopted son return home, the wrinkles on his face seemed to smooth out.

steps.speaker: Abel
steps.content: I have good news.

steps.speaker: Abel
steps.content: It's not confirmed yet, but based on your recent performance, you should be promoted to Captain of the Special Task Force next month.

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: Really?!
The young girl's eyes widened in surprise.

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: You're the best big brother in the whole wide world!

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: Demon, I heard that someone... wants to hurt Dad... Is it true?
The young man was tired, but after hearing the girl's anxious question, he still answered with a smile.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Yeah, Dad stepped on a few toes this election.
The young girl's face filled with worry.

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: What do we do...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Don't worry, I'll protect him.
After a silent pause, the girl forced a smile.

steps.speaker: Vera
steps.content: Yes, Demon, I believe you.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: You shouldn't have believed me.
Demon used his last bit of strength to snap the neck of the Corruptor in front of him. He finally succumbed to exhaustion, falling to his knees in a pool of blood.
The surrounding ruins dissolved, and Demon returned to the tiny eight-square-meter room.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I let you down...
Vera's remains rested there silently, unresponsive to Demon.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I'm a coward, a good-for-nothing piece of trash... I don't deserve your trust...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I couldn't protect Abel, and I couldn't protect you...
A finger pressed the man's dry, chapped lips.
Behind him, a pair of arms wrapped around his neck, and the cold touch made him feel familiar and at ease.
The next instant, Demon stood up suddenly and let out a bloodcurdling roar.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Ahhhhhhh!!!
Demon lifted the Corruptor who had snuck up on him in midair. Its shattered spine and innards washed away the dreamlike hallucinations.
The notebook in his breast pocket fell out, landing on the last page.
Dear brother, I hope you are well.

It's been a year and I still don't know what this place is. Every day, new faces come and old faces disappear. Every day, I look out the window, hoping to find you in the crowd, but I'm also glad that you're not among them.

Please forgive me for thinking this way... It's probably because I haven't seen you for so long.

Today, when I saw the sunset outside the window, I remembered the first time we met: Dad and I took you home, and we walked along the path in front of our house. You didn't speak, so I could only admire the scenery along the way. There was a beautiful sunset that day, just like today.

Sorry, I may not be able to survive much longer.

I don't know what others think, but I want you to know that no matter what you're doing, no matter what they say, I believe you. I will always... be grateful to have met you.

May you spend every day in peace and happiness.
Your sister Vera
The man raised his head, tears running down his cheeks.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Ve... ra...
He uttered that name one last time. All the dreams and memories disappeared.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Thank you...
Corruptor corpses piled high all around him, and the terrifying shrieks gradually fell silent.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I... I did it...
There was nothing left. Corruptors, violence, promises, warmth, his once beloved and trusting family...
Everything scattered to the freezing night wind along with the Rust.
Demon smiled and closed his eyes. He slumped to the ground, his armor landing with a dull thud.
...Wake... up...
Demon... Demon...
Demon! Wake up!
I told you I'd be back...
You can't die yet!
